generated.title: What Is the Pacific Ring of Fire? #shorts
generated.description:
Why do so many powerful earthquakes and volcanoes surround the Pacific Ocean?

Welcome to the Ring of Fire — a vast belt of tectonic plate boundaries responsible for many of the world's largest earthquakes and some of its most active volcanic regions.

From Japan and Kamchatka to Alaska and Chile, discover how subduction zones build enormous stress and unleash powerful earthquakes.

Explore the science behind one of Earth's most fascinating geological regions.

Subscribe to Next Huge Quake for earthquake science, historic earthquakes, and the latest seismic activity around the world.

Stay informed. Stay prepared.
